subTitle: Factory supply, materials, threads, fast delivery and how RFQ ordering works.

faqs.question: Are you a trading company or a factory?
faqs.answer: FerruleX is a manufacturing factory for stainless steel fittings and valves in Nanjing, China. We machine, stock and ship from our plant — not a pure trading desk — so lead times on common sizes are short and OEM custom work is reviewed in-house.

faqs.question: Where is your factory?
faqs.answer: No. 212, Lantian Road, Lukou District, Jiangning, Nanjing, China. Export RFQs go to sales@ferrulex.com or WhatsApp / phone +86 138 1403 4409. Default Incoterms are FOB Shanghai or FOB Ningbo.

faqs.question: How fast can you deliver?
faqs.answer: Stocked sizes are typically ready 5–7 days after you confirm the quote. Make-to-order is about 15–25 days in production, then transit. Name the port if you want CIF. FOB Shanghai or Ningbo is the default.

faqs.question: What stainless steel fittings do you supply?
faqs.answer: For many years we have focused on stainless steel compression fittings (double-ferrule), ball valves, needle valves, check valves, corrugated stainless steel hose, quick-screw and push-to-connect fittings, adapters, plugs, instrumentation tube and investment-cast parts — about 105 catalog lines. Materials include SS304, SS316 and SS316L.

faqs.question: Do you sell online with a shopping cart?
faqs.answer: No. This is an RFQ catalog site. Browse products, then send size, material, thread and quantity via the contact form. We reply with a factory quotation — all orders are negotiated.

faqs.question: Which thread standards are available?
faqs.answer: Common options include NPT, G (BSPP), ZG/R (BSPT) and metric threads (e.g. M5–M24). Metric and imperial tube ODs are both available on compression series.

faqs.question: What should I include in an RFQ?
faqs.answer: Send product type or SKU, tube OD / pipe size, thread standard, material (SS304 / SS316), quantity, destination country and any drawing or pressure requirement. That lets our factory quote faster.

faqs.question: Can you do OEM or custom parts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send a drawing for non-standard ends, mixed threads or private marking. We review manufacturability in-house and quote MOQ and lead time on the RFQ — see the OEM page.

faqs.question: Do you provide material certificates?
faqs.answer: Material documentation can be prepared when requested at RFQ stage. Tell us if you need MTR-style notes or third-party inspection support before we pack the order.
